name: Kisama Naga Heritage Village (Hornbill Festival)
price_unit: per person (Hornbill Festival pass ₹100/day in December)
opening_hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (December 1 - 10 hosts the famous Hornbill Festival of Festivals)
best_time: December 1 to 10 for the Hornbill Festival
rules: Showcases traditional wooden morungs (dormitories) of all 16 major Naga tribes
Sample authentic Naga culinary delicacies and bamboo shoots
visual_features: traditional Naga tribal village with massive carved wooden warrior log houses, hornbill bird motifs, and open-air performance amphitheater
description: Hornbill Festival is an annual festival celebrated from 1 to 10 of December in the Northeastern Indian state of Nagaland. The festival represents all ethnic groups of Nagaland for which it is also called the Festival of Festivals.
